data.title: Anantara Sharjah Residences
data.about:
Experience seaside luxury at Anantara Sharjah Residences by Arada Developer. Anantara Sharjah Residences at Sharjah Beach offers premium 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and penthouses.

These fully furnished residences provide stunning views of the Arabian Gulf.  The resort's amenities include a beachfront infinity pool and an overwater restaurant. This development offers a perfect balance of tranquility and adventure for both leisure and business travelers, with proximity to the Expo Centre.

characteristics_module.title: Discover Luxury Living at Anantara Sharjah Residences by Arada at Sharjah
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Anantara Sharjah Luxury Apartments includes 1 to 4-bedroom units showcasing Anatara’s style.
  • Anantara Sharjah Beachfront Residences offers panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf from every residence, offering a serene and picturesque living experience.
  • Residents benefit from the availability of concierge, valet, and private butler services, ensuring a seamless and luxurious lifestyle.
  • Nestled within the grounds of the Anantara Sharjah Resort, these residences provide direct access to the beachfront and stunning views.
  • Combining the tranquility of seaside living with top-tier amenities and services, these residences are designed to exceed expectations.
  • Enjoy exclusive wellness facilities and dining at a signature restaurant for a complete luxury experience.

location_tile.title: A Prime Beachfront Location with Stunning Views of the Arabian Gulf.
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Sharjah is rapidly emerging as a premier holiday destination, offering a wealth of cultural and recreational activities. Residents of Anantara Sharjah Residences can explore the historic Heart of Sharjah district, bustling souqs, and majestic mosques, all within a short distance from their homes. 
The city's vibrant arts and cultural scene, combined with its modern amenities, provide a perfect balance of tradition and innovation. Additionally, the close proximity to the Expo Centre and other major attractions makes Anantara Sharjah Residences.

Sharjah Beach within walking distance
3 minutes to Tender Moments Nursery 
5 minutes to Sharqan Park
5 minutes Matajer Al Mirgab Mall
20 minutes to Sharjah International Airport

seo.metaTitle: Anantara Residences Sharjah by Arada, UAE
seo.metaDescription: Find out about Anantara Sharjah Residences. Enjoy resort-style services at the 1 to 4-bedroom luxury waterfront apartments in Sharjah.

more_info.answer: Anantara Sharjah properties offer a blend of luxury, comfort, and exclusivity. These fully furnished residences, designed in line with the Anantara brand, feature panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf, smart home technology, and access to premium amenities. The strategic location within the Anantara Sharjah Resort ensures a serene beachfront lifestyle combined with top-tier services and facilities.
more_info.question: What makes Anantara Sharjah property for sale a unique investment opportunity?

more_info.answer: Anantara Sharjah beachfront residences include a range of premium 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and penthouses. Each residence is fully furnished to the highest standards, offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and direct access to the resort's luxurious amenities, such as landscaped pools, fitness centers, and a signature restaurant.
more_info.question: What types of residences are available at Anantara Sharjah beachfront residences?

more_info.answer: Residents at Anantara Residences Sharjah can enjoy a variety of world-class amenities, including landscaped pools, a signature restaurant, fitness centers, spas, kids' play areas, and much more. The development also offers exceptional services such as concierge, valet, private butler services, and access to wellness facilities, ensuring a luxurious and convenient lifestyle.
more_info.question: What amenities can residents expect at Anantara Residences Sharjah?

more_info.answer: The Anantara Sharjah Residences location is highly advantageous, being just a short drive from Dubai International Airport and nestled within the luxurious Anantara Sharjah Resort. Residents can enjoy the vibrant cultural and recreational activities in Sharjah, with proximity to key attractions such as the Heart of Sharjah district, bustling souqs, and major business centers like the Expo Centre.
more_info.question: How is the Anantara Sharjah Residences location beneficial for residents?

more_info.answer: The payment plan for purchasing a property at Anantara Sharjah is structured as a 45/55 plan, with a starting price of AED 2.29M.
